artworks.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a celestial event impacting a group of individuals and horses on a battlefield. The sky is filled with dark, swirling clouds releasing beams of light towards a central figure among horsemen and people on the ground. The light creates a powerful and divine focal point on the scene, indicating a moment of revelation. In the foreground, figures and horses react to the event amidst a chaotic scramble. The background showcases architectural structures near rolling landscapes, setting a turbulent and intense atmosphere suggestive of divine or supernatural intervention.

artworks.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a religious scene. The central figure stands on a cloud, surrounded by angels playing instruments such as harps. Rays emanate outward. Below, a group of individuals are gathered around an open space or altar, looking upward solemnly. The artist's lines and cross-hatching create depth and texture, capturing the celestial encounter.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The composition depicts three crosses with figures on them, positioned prominently in the center; the central cross is emphasized by radiant lines. The drawing is filled with figures below the crosses, appearing to be a gathering crowd, some on horseback and others standing, with many holding spears and banners. In the background, there are drawings of buildings and hills. The use of line in the drawing is detailed, capturing both human figures and landscape elements with clarity. There is an intricate play of line work to depict expressions and gestures.

artworks.title: Mysteries of the Passion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of six oval-shaped engravings depicting various scenes unfolding in historical or mythical settings. The images show intense and dynamic scenes of conflict, architecture, and gatherings, with groups of figures interacting energetically. The scenes are detailed within each oval, providing glimpses of narrative moments possibly from a larger story. The line work is intricate, and the composition of each oval creates continuity across the series.

artworks.title: Mysteries of the Passion
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10 × 12.7 cm (3 15/16 × 5 in.)
artworks.description: This image depicts six oval vignettes showing different biblical scenes. The top row includes scenes set in pastoral and domestic settings, while the bottom row portrays more intimate scenes. The intricate line work and shading suggest a vintage narrative style commonly seen in religious engravings or prints from past centuries.

artworks.title: Mysteries of the Passion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a series of biblical scenes depicted in oval frames. The image consists of eight separate scenes, each enclosed in an oval outline, illustrating various religious events. The scenes are arranged in two rows, with four ovals in each row. The drawings show different events with architectural details such as arches and columns, and a group of figures engaged in traditional religious iconography. The top row appears to depict indoor scenes with elaborate interiors, while the bottom row includes outdoor scenarios. The figures are dressed in flowing garments, surrounded by architectural and natural elements, suggesting stories from a religious context. The composition conveys a narrative through a collection of vignettes, representing religious themes.

artworks.title: Claude Deruet and his Son, Jean
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the full bodies of two individuals - one large adult figure and a smaller child-like figure - both facing forward. The adult is standing with one leg stepping forward while extending one arm downwards towards the smaller figure. The adult has long, curly hair and a beard, wearing a detailed outfit featuring an ornate collar, patterned doublet, and puffed sleeves, along with pants that have intricate designs. There is a sword attached to the adult's waist, and he wears tall boots. The child, positioned to the left of the adult, has similar long, curly hair and wears a plumed hat and a matching outfit with a long coat, holding a walking stick. Above them is a draped curtain with a large coat of arms featuring various symbols and tassels. The background depicts an ornate architectural scene, suggesting a medieval or Renaissance setting, with a cityscape visible in the distance, showing buildings and people.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "The Large Apostles"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel holding a scroll with Latin text. The illustration shows an angel with wings holding a large parchment with flowing hair and a serene expression. Radiant light is depicted behind the angel. Below the scroll, there are symbols like a chain, a key, and possibly quills. The composition is framed within a rectangle and the drawing is detailed with fine linework and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Christ
artworks.description: The image features a figure standing upright with one hand pointing upward and the other holding an orb with a cross. The figure has long hair, a beard, and is draped in a flowing garment with folds and a shawl. They are barefoot on a ground with sketchy lines. In the background are detailed scenes including a figure holding a flag on the left and a cross flanked by small figures on the right. The image is monochromatic with intricate line work.

artworks.title: The Virgin
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with hands clasped together in a prayerful position. The person's facial features are softly detailed, with eyes slightly opened, a small nose, and a gentle smile. They are wearing flowing garments - a long gown and a hooded cloak, and simple sandals. There is a halo around their head. In the background, multiple figures are gathered around an altar, with one figure ascending into the sky with a radiant halo. To the right, there is a smaller depiction of a person on a donkey led by another figure, with sparse trees and a simple horizon line.

artworks.title: Saint Peter
artworks.description: The image shows an older man standing with a serious expression. He has distinct facial features, thinning wavy hair, and a long beard. He wears a flowing robe and holds an open book and a key. A halo surrounds his head. In the background, there are smaller figures near a boat on the left and engaged in construction on the right. The background is plain, focusing on the activities.

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man holding a sword, with a halo above his head. He has a lined face, a beard, a moustache, long hair, and is wearing voluminous robes. Detailed landscape and small dynamic figures are in the background.

artworks.title: Saint Andrew
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing, carrying large cylindrical logs over his shoulder and in front of him. The man has long, wavy hair and a beard, wearing a long robe tied with a belt at the waist, and holding two fish by their tails in his hand. The background features an etching style with silhouettes of several people on a hillside, with one pointing at the main figure. There are also architectural elements, such as a building with a curved roof, and another group of people gathered nearby.

artworks.title: Saint James the Great
artworks.description: The image depicts a bearded man in a full-body view standing in a forward-facing position. The man has a long beard and long, flowing hair, wearing a long robe, a cloak, and a wide-brimmed hat with a cross insignia. He is holding a staff with his right hand and his left hand is placed on his chest. The background features classical buildings, sculptures, and a group of people engaged in various activities.

artworks.title: Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure of a person standing in a dignified pose. The individual is holding a chalice in one hand and lifting a finger from the other hand. The person's facial features appear gentle and serene, with downcast eyes and long, wavy hair that falls around their shoulders. The figure is wearing a voluminous robe with wide sleeves that drapes down to cover most of the feet, leaving a few toes visible. A halo encircles the head. There are no visible items of jewelry. In the background to the left, there are trees and possibly a distant town or city. To the right, there are several smaller figures and a fortified structure.

artworks.title: Saint James the Less
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing upright in a classical art style. The person is facing forward, holding a staff in one hand and a book in the other. They have detailed facial features, a long beard, and shoulder-length hair. The figure wears a flowing robe with large sleeves. The background features a street with classical architecture and distant figures engaged in activity.

artworks.title: Saint Thomas
artworks.description: The image depicts an older man standing, with a staff in his left hand and an open book in his right hand. He has a beard, short hair, facial lines, and is dressed in robes with sandals. Around him are various figures, along with a building and trees in the background. The scene is detailed with fine lines.

artworks.title: Saint Philip
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length figure of a man standing upright. His position is frontal, with his body turned slightly to his left as he holds a large book open in his left hand, and a long staff topped with a small cross in his right hand. The man's facial features include a solemn expression, defined by detailed line work emphasizing his eyes and mouth, and he has shaggy, medium-length hair. He is wearing a long, flowing robe that appears heavy and layered, with ample fabric draping over his shoulders and arms. A halo-like circle surrounds his head. Barefoot, he stands prominently against a detailed background featuring architectural elements like tall buildings and statues, with small groups of people engaged in various activities.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded older man standing in a frontal position, slightly turned to his right, with his head facing upward. He has a long flowing beard and an expression suggesting contemplation or prayer. There is an aureole around his head. His hair is long and wavy, flowing down from the top of his head. He is dressed in a long robe with a cloak draped over it, which falls in folds to his feet, partially covering his bare toes. In his right hand, he holds a large key, while his left hand is placed on his chest. The background includes detailed scenes with various figures, structures, people, and a group involved in a mechanical contraption to the right, as well as buildings and trees, giving an urban setting to the environment.

artworks.title: Saint Matthias
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a person standing in a slight profile view, facing to the right. The person's head is turned downward. They have long, flowing hair and a beard. They are wearing a large, voluminous robe. The figure holds a staff in their left hand and a book in their hands. Above the figure's head, there is a circular halo. The background comprises a detailed street scene with many smaller figures and various buildings, including arches. A group of people can be seen gathered in the street.

artworks.title: Saint Simon
artworks.description: The image shows a full body portrait of an elderly man standing slightly hunched forward. His facial features are aged, with a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and he wears round spectacles. The man has thin, balding hair and is draped in a large garment resembling a cloak or mantle. One arm covers his mouth, while the other holds an open book angled towards him. He is barefoot. Above his head, there is a circular halo. The background shows a busy street scene with a crowd of people around classical buildings.

artworks.title: Saint Matthew
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in profile with his hands in a prayer position. He has a long beard, a prominent nose, and a halo above his head. His hair is short and curly, and he is wearing a long cloak and sandals. He is holding or leaning on a staff with his left hand. In the background, there is an architectural structure with statues and figures, as well as a tree and smaller figures. The setting appears to be outdoors with foliage and a clear sky.

artworks.title: Saint Thaddeus
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with long hair and a beard. A halo is above their head. They are wearing a long garment and holding a large axe. The background features Renaissance-style buildings and small figures engaged in various activities.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "The Customs of Lorraine"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative title page for a legal document. The drawing features an ornate frame with the title "Coustumes Generales du Duche de Lorraine." Two classical figures stand on either side holding drapes apart. Above the title, an intricate coat of arms is centered and adorned with symmetrical scrollwork. At the top center, an arm emerges from scrollwork holding an object. The bottom of the frame features a Latin inscription "Alspinal Par Ambroise Ambroise Imprimeur au lieu 1631." The entire image is detailed with fine line work.
